epics.title: UK checkout, coupons & mock secure payment
Order history, account hub & customer support
API contract, analytics hooks & M3 release quality

work_items.title: Auth & users API with Flutter session and account shell
work_items.description: Implement NestJS auth module (registerUser, loginUser, refreshTokens, logoutUser) with bcrypt/argon2 password hashing, JWT access (~15m) and hashed refresh rotation; users module (getCurrentUser, deleteCurrentUser soft-delete/anonymize PII). Add Flutter AuthNotifier, secure token storage, dio interceptors, Login/Register on SCR-09, AccountScreen SCR-10 profile read, logout, and account deletion with privacy copy.
work_items.estimate_rationale: JWT refresh rotation, secure storage, delete-account GDPR flow, and six authenticated operations drive size. | backend_developer: Six authenticated operations plus JWT refresh rotation, global guards, and Supertest e2e dominate; Flutter secure storage and interceptors add a full parallel track on top of greenfield Nest modules.; concerns: Work item spans backend and mobile; Prisma User/RefreshToken exist but auth modules are absent. Account soft-delete/anonymize rules and OpenAPI error shapes need explicit test cases.

work_items.title: Cart API, guest header, merge and CartScreen
work_items.description: Implement cart module: getCart, addCartItem, updateCartItem, removeCartItem with per-variant stock caps and integer pence snapshots; guest carts via X-Guest-Cart-Id; signed-in Cart persistence; mergeGuestCart on login combining matching variant SKUs. Flutter CartNotifier, guest id persistence, merge after auth, SCR-05 with quantity steppers and totals in minor units.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Guest vs user cart duality, merge rules, stock-enforced PATCH, and five cart endpoints. | backend_developer: Dual guest and signed-in cart paths, stock-capped PATCH, price snapshots, and merge-on-login transaction logic drive size beyond straight CRUD.; concerns: GuestCart/GuestCartItem are in the M3 contract but missing from the run Prisma schema—migration and seed work lands here or blocks the module.

work_items.title: Checkout preview, UK shipping rules and CheckoutScreen
work_items.description: Implement checkout module previewCheckout: mainland UK address validation, flat-rate shipping below free-delivery threshold and zero shipping at/above seed threshold (e.g. £75), server-calculated subtotal/shipping/total in GBP pence, address snapshot JSON. Flutter CheckoutScreen SCR-06 contact and UK address form, order review lines matching server preview (coupon field wired in WI-017).
work_items.estimate_rationale: UK shipping threshold math in pence plus address form and server-total parity on SCR-06. | backend_developer: Single previewCheckout with UK postcode rules and pence shipping threshold is bounded server logic; SCR-06 is mostly form and total parity without coupon math yet.; concerns: Shipping/env thresholds must match seed and OpenAPI examples; guest vs bearer cart resolution on preview shares cart header semantics with WI-014.

work_items.title: Order creation, stock reservation, mock payment and confirmation flow
work_items.description: Extend checkout createOrder with Idempotency-Key, StockReservation per variant, Order/OrderItem price-name snapshots, pending_payment state; payments module confirmMockPayment (no card fields) transitioning to paid and consuming reservations; release on failed/cancelled mock. Flutter CheckoutNotifier idempotency key, MockPaymentScreen SCR-07, OrderConfirmationScreen SCR-08 with order number and snapshotted lines.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Idempotent checkout, reservation concurrency, mock payment state machine, and payment plus confirmation screens. | backend_developer: Idempotent createOrder, row-level stock reservations, order snapshots, mock payment state machine, and three Flutter checkout screens are the largest transactional slice.; concerns: Depends on WI-017 for coupon-aware totals; current Payment model requires stripePaymentIntentId while mock flow needs MockPaymentSession/CheckoutIdempotency schema alignment.

work_items.title: Coupon validation in checkout preview and checkout UI
work_items.description: Add Coupon, CouponCategory, CouponProduct, CouponRedemption Prisma models and seed active promos; enforce single non-stackable coupon in previewCheckout (minimum order, category/SKU restrictions, discount in pence). Flutter coupon entry on SCR-06 with server error messages and revised totals.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Restriction matrix, one-code rule, and preview recalculation shared with shipping totals. | backend_developer: Coupon eligibility matrix (min subtotal, category/SKU scopes, single code) folds into previewCheckout recalculation plus seed and SCR-06 error surfacing.; concerns: CouponCategory/CouponProduct join models may be absent from run schema; percent vs fixed pence rounding must match OpenAPI totals.

work_items.title: Wishlist API and WishlistScreen
work_items.description: Implement wishlist module (listWishlist, addWishlistItem, removeWishlistItem) for authenticated users by productId. Flutter WishlistNotifier, SCR-13 list, save/remove affordances on SCR-04 and SCR-03 with login gate for guests per Release 2 policy.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Three CRUD-ish endpoints plus list/detail UI hooks and auth gating. | backend_developer: Three authenticated wishlist endpoints with unique (userId, productId) are small; Flutter is list screen plus two save/remove affordances with login gate.; concerns: Depends on WI-019 product identity in list/detail; duplicate add should return stable 409 or idempotent 200 per contract.

work_items.title: Home merchandising and catalog API with browse screens
work_items.description: Extend catalog module: getHome (banners, featured, new arrivals), listCategories, getCategoryBySlug, getCatalogFacets, listProducts (search/filter/sort), getProductById, listProductReviews; maintain Pass 1 API fallback when health fails. Flutter HomeScreen SCR-01, CategoriesScreen SCR-02, ProductListingScreen SCR-03, ProductDetailScreen SCR-04 with variants, lighting specs, reviews preview/navigation, bundled images, and pence-to-GBP display.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Seven catalog operations, facets/filters/sort, four browse screens, and offline fallback integration. | backend_developer: M2 already ships seven catalog/health operations and four browse screens—remaining work is HomeBanner/new-arrivals merchandising, mapper parity, and health-driven API fallback wiring.; concerns: HomeBanner model and richer getHome payload may need schema/seed updates; offline catalog.json must stay aligned with API mappers.
work_items.estimate_notes: reconciled by the PM: M2 already delivers the seven catalog/health operations and four browse screens, so 8 over-counts greenfield scope; 6 credits the focused remainder (HomeBanner/getHome merchandising, schema/seed, mapper parity, health-driven fallback) with one point buffer for cross-layer offline catalog.json alignment the builder flagged.

work_items.title: Customer orders API and order history screens
work_items.description: Implement orders module listOrders (paginated) and getOrderById for authenticated customers with customer-facing status mapping (processing/shipped/delivery) and seeded tracking fields. Flutter OrdersNotifier, OrderHistoryScreen SCR-11, OrderDetailScreen SCR-12; guest checkout directed to register/login for history.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Pagination, status mapping, and two order screens with snapshotted line display. | backend_developer: Paginated listOrders and getOrderById with customer status mapping and snapshotted lines are read paths with straightforward Jest/Supertest coverage.; concerns: Requires seeded orders in post-payment states from WI-016; guest-order visibility vs auth-only history must match product policy.

work_items.title: Production lighting catalog seed, bundled imagery and IMAGE_SOURCES
work_items.description: Expand Prisma seed to 18–30 UK lighting SKUs with variants, stock per variant, lighting attributes, brands, coupons cross-ref, and merchandising weights; download real photos from stanpro2.folio3.site into app/assets/catalog/images and/or API static paths; author docs/IMAGE_SOURCES.md; align catalog.json offline fallback with API mappers for demo parity.
work_items.estimate_rationale: 18–30 SKU data entry, asset pipeline, provenance doc, and dual offline/API consistency. | backend_developer: 18–30 SKU authoring, variant stock, coupon cross-refs, image download pipeline, and dual API/offline catalog parity is mostly data and asset labor.; concerns: External image fetch from stanpro2.folio3.site can fail CI; licensing and IMAGE_SOURCES.md completeness are easy to underestimate.

work_items.title: OpenAPI parity and Dart dio client regeneration
work_items.description: Update NestJS Swagger for all M3 operations (28 capped ops plus getHealth excluded from cap), ensure /api/docs-json matches implemented controllers, regenerate Flutter OpenAPI dart-dio client, and fix breaking DTO drift across repositories.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Full contract diff, client regen, and cross-module DTO alignment after feature APIs land. | backend_developer: Full Swagger parity across nine modules, docs-json contract tests, OpenAPI generator run, and fixing DTO drift in every Flutter repository is integration-heavy tail work.; concerns: Depends on WI-024 and all feature modules; partial implementations force multiple regen/fix cycles; optional vs required security on cart routes must match spec.

work_items.title: Customer support screen and static UK content
work_items.description: Add support_content.dart with UK phone, email, business hours, FAQ WebView link covering shipping, mock payment demo, and returns-via-support policy; SupportScreen SCR-14 and navigation from SCR-10 Account hub.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Static copy, WebView, and one screen with account navigation link. | frontend_developer: Static UK copy module, themed SupportScreen, go_router SCR-14, webview_flutter FAQ with load/error UI, semantic labels, and widget tests; account hub link is small if SCR-10 lands in parallel.; concerns: SCR-10 Account hub is not in the app router yet despite navigation from SCR-10; FAQ URL/host and whether FAQ opens in-app WebView vs external browser may need product copy; WebView adds dependency and platform test surface; returns-via-support policy text must match legal/PM source of truth.

work_items.title: Forgot and reset password stub API and auth UI
work_items.description: Implement forgotPassword and resetPassword with generic responses, PasswordResetToken storage, stub/logged reset delivery documented for demo; ForgotPasswordScreen and ResetPasswordScreen flows on SCR-09 without email enumeration.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Token lifecycle, stub provider docs, and two auth sub-screens. | backend_developer: Two auth stubs with hashed PasswordResetToken lifecycle, generic responses, and two Flutter sub-screens are smaller than core login but still need e2e and enumeration-safe copy.; concerns: Stub email/logging behavior needs a documented demo path; token expiry and one-time use must align with OpenAPI without real SMTP.

work_items.title: Analytics event hooks for browse and purchase funnel
work_items.description: Add ProductViewEvent model and server log/stub persistence optional; Flutter analytics abstraction firing product view, add-to-cart, and purchase completion events (log or stub provider) without blocking checkout; wire from catalog, cart, and order confirmation flows per NFR-10.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Thin instrumentation layer across three existing notifiers/screens. | backend_developer: Optional ProductViewEvent persistence plus a thin Flutter analytics facade on three existing touchpoints is instrumentation only if checkout stays non-blocking.; concerns: Server persistence vs log-only stub should be decided up front to avoid scope creep; product view volume may need rate limiting in staging.

work_items.title: M3 QA round, CI green and staging infra verification
work_items.description: Execute structured M3 QA against US-001–US-014 journeys; fix defects; ensure flutter analyze and flutter test green, Jest unit and Supertest e2e for auth, cart, checkout, orders, coupons, wishlist, and home endpoints; verify docker-compose staging, GitHub Actions, getHealth liveness, and Release 2 sign-off checklist.
work_items.estimate_rationale: Full-journey QA, cross-stack test fixes, and pipeline/staging verification before sign-off. | deployment_engineer: Cross-stack M3 QA (14 user journeys, 14 screens), defect fixes, and green gates on Flutter analyze/tests plus Jest/Supertest across auth/cart/checkout/orders/coupons/wishlist/home dominate effort more than a single infra pass.; concerns: Assumes WI-013–WI-025 are substantially complete; flaky Supertest/e2e and CI emulator/integration_test setup often hide a day of stabilization; staging docker-compose and GitHub Actions need non-repo secrets and seeded DB state for repeatable journeys; stack mentions Stripe test mode while payments WI uses mock confirm—verify alignment before sign-off checklist.

milestones.name: Release 2 — shopper depth & production catalog
milestones.goal: Deliver Lumen M3 on Pass 1 baseline: registered and guest shopping with API-backed home merchandising, search/filter/sort, 18–30 SKU production-style catalog with bundled imagery, server cart with login merge, UK checkout with coupons and mock secure payment, order confirmation and signed-in order tracking, wishlist, support and password-reset demo, OpenAPI/client parity within 28 operations, and green flutter analyze/test plus server tests after one M3 QA round.
